MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is it important to say tones correctly in Mandarin? (1 mark)
   A. Because tones make the word longer
   B. Because tones are only for songs
   C. Because tones are only used in writing
   D. Because the tone can change the meaning of a word

2. What does 我 (wǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I, me
   B. Hello
   C. Teacher
   D. Goodbye

3. Fill the blank: 椅子在桌子____。 (The chair is under the table.) (1 mark)
   A. 里
   B. 下
   C. 上
   D. 是

4. Which two syllables blend to make 椅子? (1 mark)
   A. zhuō and zi
   B. bīng and xiāng
   C. yǐ and zi
   D. diàn and shì

5. What does 昨天 zuótiān mean? (1 mark)
   A. Yesterday
   B. Morning
   C. Today
   D. Tomorrow

6. Which Chinese word means "which number, how many"? (1 mark)
   A. 送 sòng
   B. 几 jǐ
   C. 唱歌 chànggē
   D. 朋友 péngyou

7. What do the three words 早饭, 午饭 and 晚饭 have in common? (1 mark)
   A. They are drinks
   B. They are fruits
   C. They are names of meals
   D. They are days

8. What does 我喜欢吃香蕉 mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am eating tea
   B. I have a banana tree
   C. I do not like bananas
   D. I like to eat bananas

9. What does 苹果 (píngguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Meat
   B. Drinks
   C. Chicken (meat)
   D. Apple

10. Why is it good to retell what you heard in your own words? (1 mark)
   A. It makes you forget
   B. It shows you understood the key points
   C. It is only for teachers
   D. It is a way to play

11. Which body part helps you hear? (1 mark)
   A. 手 shǒu
   B. 耳朵 ěrduo
   C. 眼睛 yǎnjing
   D. 鼻子 bízi

12. What does 摸鼻子 mō bízi tell you to do? (1 mark)
   A. Look at your nose
   B. Touch your nose
   C. Wash your nose
   D. Cover your mouth

13. What does 风很大 mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is small
   B. The rain is heavy
   C. The wind is very strong
   D. The cloud is light

14. Which sentence means "Good morning!"? (1 mark)
   A. 我叫小明。
   B. 谢谢!
   C. 再见!
   D. 早上好!

15. Which Chinese word means "thank you"? (1 mark)
   A. 叫 jiào
   B. 我 wǒ
   C. 你好 nǐ hǎo
   D. 谢谢 xièxie

16. Which word is pronounced fángjiān? (1 mark)
   A. 椅子
   B. 右边
   C. 房间
   D. 放

17. Fill the blank: 厨房里有____。 (There is a fridge in the kitchen.) (1 mark)
   A. 电视
   B. 冰箱
   C. 床
   D. 沙发

18. Which sentence means "There is a television in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室里有床。
   B. 客厅里有电视。
   C. 浴室在花园旁边。
   D. 电视在客厅。

19. What does 清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Week (short form)
   B. Mosque
   C. Church
   D. Today

20. What does 学校 (xuéxiào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. School
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Mosque
   D. To go

21. What does 十 (shí) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Ten
   C. Two
   D. Three

22. What does 我们 (wǒmen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. We
   B. Everybody
   C. They
   D. Candle

23. What does 脚 (jiǎo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Shoulder
   B. Foot
   C. Head
   D. To use

24. Read the pinyin: wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I use my eyes to see.
   B. I use my mouth to speak.
   C. I have two eyes.
   D. I use my ears to hear.

25. Which Chinese word means "ear"? (1 mark)
   A. 刷牙 shuāyá
   B. 看 kàn
   C. 耳朵 ěrduo
   D. 牙 yá

26. What does 早上 zǎoshang mean? (1 mark)
   A. Afternoon
   B. Night
   C. Morning
   D. Evening

27. What does decoding a word mean? (1 mark)
   A. Copying it
   B. Hiding it
   C. Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   D. Drawing it

28. Which stroke goes from top to bottom? (1 mark)
   A. 提 tí
   B. 横 héng
   C. 捺 nà
   D. 竖 shù

29. Which sentence means "This is my father."? (1 mark)
   A. 我家有五口人。
   B. 那是我哥哥。
   C. 那是我弟弟。
   D. 这是我爸爸。

30. What does 女儿 (nǚ'ér) mean? (1 mark)
   A. And
   B. Is, am, are
   C. Younger sister
   D. Daughter

31. Which word is pronounced wòshì? (1 mark)
   A. 门
   B. 卧室
   C. 里
   D. 床

32. Which sentence means "On Wednesday I go to school."? (1 mark)
   A. 星期五,去清真寺。
   B. 星期天,去教堂。
   C. 我星期三去学校。
   D. 明天是星期四。

33. How many strokes does 三 have? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 4
   C. 3
   D. 5

34. What does 晚饭 (wǎnfàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Grapes
   B. Dinner
   C. Mango
   D. To drink

35. Which sentence is correctly punctuated? (1 mark)
   A. 我吃米饭!你呢。
   B. 我吃米饭? 你呢。
   C. 我吃米饭。你呢?
   D. 我吃米饭、你呢、

36. Which sentence means "I have two eyes."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用眼睛看。
   B. 我有两只眼睛。
   C. 我用嘴巴说。
   D. 我用耳朵听。

37. What does 听 (tīng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two (before a counting word)
   B. Shoulder
   C. To listen, to hear
   D. To brush teeth

38. What does 肩膀 (jiānbǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To speak
   B. Tooth
   C. Shoulder
   D. To look, to see

39. What does 很 (hěn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Big
   B. Very
   C. Cloud
   D. Small

40. Which word is pronounced shàngmiàn? (1 mark)
   A. 冰箱
   B. 放
   C. 上面
   D. 沙发

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write the eight basic strokes' names in Chinese with pinyin. Any six earn full marks. (3 marks)

42. Arrange the words to make a sentence and translate: 礼物 / 送 / 朋友 / 我. (3 marks)

43. Explain the difference between skimming and scanning. (2 marks)

44. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 八 and 玩. (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

46. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The garden is on the right of the house." (3 marks)

47. Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù. (2 marks)

48. Write a dialogue of five lines in Chinese with pinyin between two learners about a food picture: ask what it is, answer, ask if they like it, and reply. (5 marks)

49. Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在. (3 marks)

50. Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning. (4 marks)

51. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The bed is in the bedroom." (2 marks)

52. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 客厅 and 咖啡. (2 marks)

53. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The television is in the living room." (2 marks)

54. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: nǐ ne? (2 marks)

55. Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings. (3 marks)

56. Give three ways to make a reading club work well. (3 marks)

57. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng. (2 marks)

58. Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning. (3 marks)

59. Write two sentences about your family with 这是, and give pinyin. (3 marks)

60. Describe how to make the character 手 using local materials. (3 marks)

61. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 左边 and 房间. (2 marks)

62. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "Today it rains." (2 marks)

63. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 喝 and 牙. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Because the tone can change the meaning of a word
   A different tone can mean a different word, such as mā and mǎ.

2. A — I, me
   我 (wǒ) means I, me.

3. B — 下
   下 means under.

4. C — yǐ and zi
   yǐ + zi = yǐzi, chair.

5. A — Yesterday
   昨天 is yesterday.

6. B — 几 jǐ
   几 (jǐ) means which number, how many.

7. C — They are names of meals
   饭 is meal, and the first characters tell the time of day.

8. D — I like to eat bananas
   喜欢 is like, 吃 is eat and 香蕉 is banana.

9. D — Apple
   苹果 (píngguǒ) means apple.

10. B — It shows you understood the key points
   Retelling keeps the main ideas and shows understanding.

11. B — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 are ears.

12. B — Touch your nose
   摸 is to touch.

13. C — The wind is very strong
   风 is wind and 很大 is very big or strong.

14. D — 早上好!
   早上好! (zǎoshang hǎo!) means "Good morning!".

15. D — 谢谢 xièxie
   谢谢 (xièxie) means thank you.

16. C — 房间
   房间 is pronounced fángjiān and means room.

17. B — 冰箱
   The fridge is in the kitchen.

18. B — 客厅里有电视。
   客厅里有电视。 (kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì.) means "There is a television in the living room.".

19. B — Mosque
   清真寺 (qīngzhēnsì) means mosque.

20. A — School
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

21. B — Ten
   十 (shí) means ten.

22. A — We
   我们 (wǒmen) means we.

23. B — Foot
   脚 (jiǎo) means foot.

24. A — I use my eyes to see.
   wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. is 我用眼睛看。, which means "I use my eyes to see.".

25. C — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

26. C — Morning
   早上 is morning.

27. C — Using letters and sounds to work out how to say it
   Decoding uses letter-sound knowledge.

28. D — 竖 shù
   竖 is the vertical stroke.

29. D — 这是我爸爸。
   这是我爸爸。 (zhè shì wǒ bàba.) means "This is my father.".

30. D — Daughter
   女儿 (nǚ'ér) means daughter.

31. B — 卧室
   卧室 is pronounced wòshì and means bedroom.

32. C — 我星期三去学校。
   我星期三去学校。 (wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.) means "On Wednesday I go to school.".

33. C — 3
   三 is three horizontal lines.

34. B — Dinner
   晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

35. C — 我吃米饭。你呢?
   A statement ends with 。 and a question with ?.

36. B — 我有两只眼睛。
   我有两只眼睛。 (wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.) means "I have two eyes.".

37. C — To listen, to hear
   听 (tīng) means to listen, to hear.

38. C — Shoulder
   肩膀 (jiānbǎng) means shoulder.

39. B — Very
   很 (hěn) means very.

40. C — 上面
   上面 is pronounced shàngmiàn and means above.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: 横 héng, 竖 shù, 撇 piě, 捺 nà, 点 diǎn, 提 tí, 横折 héngzhé, 竖钩 shùgōu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for six or more.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 My friend gives me a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the translation.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 八: bā, eight. 玩: wán, to play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: 花园在房子右边。 huāyuán zài fángzi yòubian.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: A: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? B: 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo. A: 你喜欢吃香蕉吗? nǐ xǐhuan chī xiāngjiāo ma? B: 我喜欢。 wǒ xǐhuan. A: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line with pinyin.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: 床在卧室。 chuáng zài wòshì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: 客厅: kètīng, living room. 咖啡: kāfēi, coffee.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: 电视在客厅。 diànshì zài kètīng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: And you?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying tone changes meaning, 2 marks for a correct pair with meanings.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be kind and do not laugh at mistakes, listen while others read, take turns fairly and help others who find reading hard.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

58. (3 marks)
   Answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba. 这是我妈妈。 zhè shì wǒ māma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence, 1 mark for correct pinyin.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: Choose pebbles, sand, maize grains, sticks or plasticine. Lay out each stroke in the correct order: 撇, 横, 横, 竖钩. Check the order with a partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the material, 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for checking.

61. (2 marks)
   Answer: 左边: zuǒbian, left side. 房间: fángjiān, room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

62. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

63. (2 marks)
   Answer: 喝: hē, to drink. 牙: yá, tooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
